  },
  "scores": {
    "architecture": 9,
    "behavior": 8,
    "authority_security": 8,
    "validation": 8,
    "overall": 8
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "C20-R2-F1 (medium; remaining protected-history ownership gap): Confirm the history scope's write-ahead ownership before creating its Keychain key. authority/harness_history.rs:459 returns save_with(...).is_ok(), and the already-known branch returns true without checking durability. authority.rs:1812 deliberately treats StoreError::Unconfirmed as Ok with durability_unconfirmed=true. admit_history_write therefore admits the save and harness/history.rs:200 can put a new scope key despite unconfirmed ownership. A crash that restores the last confirmed document loses the harness_history scope entry; after relaunch, forget_harness_history (:536) derives cleanup keys only from that document, so removing the tenant deletes the directory but leaves its history key in the Keychain. The new in-flight fence fixes the concurrent-save race but cannot recover this lost durable ownership. Apply the confirmed-write-ahead rule already used by harness_identity::begin_write, including when an earlier unconfirmed scope remains known only in memory. Acceptance: with the first scope-note save and confirmation unconfirmed, a production-interface test must show no new history-key Put or sealed record and a truthful save failure; after confirmation succeeds, saving/relaunch from the confirmed document and tenant deletion must remove both records and key. Include crash-snapshot recovery and a guard against bypassing confirmation through the known-scope branch."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "Make the sleep test's timing match its name more precisely: after_sleep_an_expired_sign_in_is_renewed_before_anything_is_sent issues a 12-second token and waits 7 seconds. It deterministically exercises the renewal margin after the sleep notification, rather than proving passage beyond the actual exp claim. Assert/advance beyond the issued expiry in a bounded clock test; retain the disclosed distinction from physical hardware sleep.",
    "Update follow-ups.md F2's description of write removing the in-flight reservation: the implementation now correctly keeps it until settle_write under the ownership-settlement lock."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Independent read-only review. No application edits, mutating test/build reruns, application/engine launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. The remaining durability finding is established from production control flow and the store's documented crash semantics, not a newly executed runtime reproduction.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints match independently recomputed values. Verified the 689-entry source inventory, 354 referenced hashes, run logs/artifacts, shared dependency input/scratch/installed equivalence and C19 attempt-06's passing predecessor receipt. No fingerprint or transport blocker was found.",
    "Prior F1 is addressed by invalidating latest at turn completion and refusing renewal when the current export is unavailable. The new tests actually select refused, unanswered and refused-restore modes and cover the successful-A/refused-B/renew-C sequence. F2/F3 token writes now use confirmed write-ahead ownership, atomic in-flight settlement, record comparison and shared grant serialization; tests cover cancellation, sign-out, reset and both re-sign-in/rotation orders.",
    "Prior F4's concurrent history-save/removal/reset paths are fenced and tested, reset purges the history directory, and launch sweeps removed tenants' directories. Prior F5 now asks before unreadable-record deletion and has frontend and native keyboard evidence. The separate first-history-key durability defect above remains; the remediation tests do not exercise that path.",
    "The recorded check run passes 408 frontend tests and 211 core unit tests. The scoped test run passes 20 harness_identity_history tests and four browser_callback host tests. Inspected the 52 mutation results and their named guards; all detect the submitted mutations, with three passing baselines per target. These results do not cover the remaining unconfirmed history-scope case.",
    "Twelve recorded C20 native checks pass against executable 10c18c72778210fe5c35b8dcd0dc0e0eeb0b2bba650cee493d4218fc7f6d749e. Inspected the driver, observations and relevant AX records for sign-in, renewal, protected history, unreadable deletion and offline read/export/reconnect without automatic resume. Synthetic browser/IdP/Gateway and sleep notification stand-ins do not establish live provider behavior, physical sleep or spoken VoiceOver.",
    "Recomputed the six workload statistics: save p95 149.00 ms, list 29.09 ms, open 52.36 ms, resume-ready 804.59 ms, refresh/restart 341.82 ms and peak process-tree RSS 493.7 MiB. All fit the unchanged registered limits. The registration discloses drafting before registration; retained measurements follow registration.",
    "This verdict covers C20 in the supplied integrated C19-C22 tree. It does not approve C21, C22 or cumulative P06, nor claim C25 live qualification or C26 signed-package acceptance. Architecture remains 9 for focused identity/history modules and native authority integration; behavior, authority/security and validation remain below 9 because durable ownership and cleanup of a newly created history key are not yet guaranteed."
  ],
